name: Flow Wave
summary:
Flow Wave is a hands-only mixed reality runner built on a flight game most of us played as a kid: your hand out of a car window, riding the wind.

A portal opens in your room onto an endless vaporwave sunset. Pinch the paper plane hovering in front of you and throw it at the portal. From then on, your hand is the plane. Roll your hand like a wing to slide left and right, lift your fingertips to climb. 

THE WORLD COMES TO YOU
